principle: One deduplicated confirmed form submission and one real qualified call are the only Primary actions. Every tap, view and diagnostic becomes Secondary.
bidding_context: All five campaigns run TARGET_SPEND (Maximize Clicks), which does not use conversion goals to bid. The damage today is reporting and attribution contamination, not bid distortion. This must be fixed BEFORE any move to Maximize Conversions.

conversion_action_changes.name: Ambient Cooling - LP -Submit Lead Forms
conversion_action_changes.target: PRIMARY (unchanged) - the single Primary form action
conversion_action_changes.reason: Correct as configured. Becomes the sole Primary form action.

conversion_action_changes.name: Visit Thank you page - Submit Form
conversion_action_changes.reason: Duplicate of 6885463625. Two Primary SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM/WEBSITE actions on the same thank-you path double-count one lead.

conversion_action_changes.name: Calls from ads
conversion_action_changes.target: PRIMARY (unchanged) - the qualified-call action bound to the call asset
conversion_action_changes.reason: 60-second minimum already meets the qualified-call rule. This is the action the call asset resolves to via USE_ACCOUNT_LEVEL_CALL_CONVERSION_ACTION.

conversion_action_changes.name: Ambient Cooling - Lp - Phone call leads
conversion_action_changes.reason: Distinct path from 1068114183 (website forwarding number vs ad call asset), so both stay Primary without double counting. 30s is too short to qualify an HVAC service call; 60s matches the ad-call action.

conversion_action_changes.name: Call BTN Click
conversion_action_changes.reason: Measures a telephone-link tap, not a connected or qualified call. A tap is a diagnostic signal. Keep it for click-to-call diagnostics, never for bidding.

conversion_action_changes.name: WC Calls
conversion_action_changes.reason: client.yaml records whatconverts_expected: false, but WhatConverts IS live on all five paid pages (wc_visitor, wc_client, wc_client_current, wc_swap cookies and localStorage). Sources conflict; do not change until confirmed.

conversion_action_changes.name: Clicks to call + Local actions (Google-hosted)
conversion_action_changes.reason: Google-hosted local actions. Already excluded from the Conversions column; they do not contaminate Search reporting.

campaign_conversion_goal_changes.reason: CONTACT/WEBSITE is what makes 'Call BTN Click' (a tel tap) and 'WC Lead' biddable. CONTACT/CALL_FROM_ADS does the same for 'WC Calls'. Removing both leaves only confirmed form submissions and real calls.

call_asset_binding.target: Bind explicitly to conversion action 1068114183 'Calls from ads' (call_conversion_reporting_state=USE_RESOURCE_LEVEL_CALL_CONVERSION_ACTION)
call_asset_binding.reason: Removes dependence on whatever the account default happens to be, so the qualified 60-second call action cannot be silently re-pointed.

deduplication.form: One ONE_PER_CLICK action keyed on the Gravity Forms entry ID as lead_id.
deduplication.call: Ad-call and website-call paths are mutually exclusive per session; both 60s minimum.
deduplication.offline: Data Manager API keyed on lead_id + gclid; never re-upload an existing lead_id.

blocking_prerequisite: Gravity Forms hidden fields input_9..input_15 are ALL EMPTY on a click carrying gclid, gbraid, wbraid and all five UTMs. No click ID reaches the form, so offline conversion import is impossible until dynamic population is configured. This conversion plan cannot deliver sold-job attribution until that landing-page defect is fixed.

test_matrix.expect: exactly 1 Primary form conversion, lead_id present, gclid present

test_matrix.case: Paid click -> tel tap, no call

test_matrix.expect: conversion recorded, no gclid, excluded from paid ROAS
Consent Mode v2 modelled, no client-side identifiers stored

open_questions: Is WhatConverts the intended call-tracking platform? It is live on all five paid pages but client.yaml records whatconverts_expected: false. Answer determines whether WC Calls / WC Lead become Secondary or stay Primary with corrected categories.
